HediffDef.label: catharsis implant
HediffDef.description: This implant was created by harvesting the brain material of pawns trapped in a mental break loop.

HediffDef.label: Happy-Chappy implant
HediffDef.description: Artificial happiness, distilled moment by moment. Sometimes, you don't need to understand why you're happy. The feeling is enough.

HediffDef.label: hedonic elite implant
HediffDef.description: This implant is given to the highest government officials as a way of rewarding them for surpassing quota. It is so strong that it completely overpowers any remorse they may have for selling entire nations into Vacuous experimentation and slavery.\n\nNon-Vacuous who have this implant are known as 'Hedonic Elite' for the rapturous joy they experience while this implant is active… and for the terrible lack of empathy they show towards anyone else.

HediffDef.label: pleasure chip implant
HediffDef.description: Artificial happiness, now created by a tiny custom brain organ housed inside the implant. It is part of the Hedonism series of implants developed by the Vacuous and awarded to those who meet their subject quotas.

HediffDef.label: prototype apathy implant
HediffDef.description: An incredibly powerful mental implant found in a soldier on a distant battlefield who stood at attention until he died from heatstroke standing up.

HediffDef.label: Reflective-Happy-Chappy implant
HediffDef.description: Artificial happiness, distilled by an implant. The implant tells you: Life is a game. Enjoy it.
